lead: Mary Kom has built a public profile as an Indian boxer, born on 1 March 1982 in Manipur.
As of 2026, she is 44 years old, and her birth date places her under the Pisces sign.
She has held the office of member of Rajya Sabha and has been recognised with Arjuna Award and Padma Bhushan.
This profile collects the Mary facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Mary Kom — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Mary Kom was born on 1 March 1982 in Manipur, and holds Indian nationality.
She received her education at Manipur University and National Institute of Open Schooling.

sections.heading: Mary Kom — Career and Professional Work
paras: Mary Kom works primarily as a boxer and politician.
She has held the following offices: member of Rajya Sabha (2016–2022).
She has taken part in 2012 Summer Olympics, 2014 Asian Games, 2010 Asian Games, boxing at the 2012 Summer Olympics – women's flyweight and 2018 Commonwealth Games.
